summary: No reachable security issue. The new situationOf branch (src/advice/preflop.ts:120-126) reads only PlayerView-public fields (view.actions after voidedBets, view.seat, view.players.length) and the static APPLICABLE_SPOTS table, so bots calling recommend() gain no access to hidden cards or deck state. No imports were added in src/advice or src/bots; eslint on the four changed source files (advice import allow-list tools/lint/headless-boundary.js:303-325 and bot determinism/boundary rules) passes clean. The tag.ts change is a type-only cast (`as SpotType`) on a Map lookup; a key with no entry returns undefined and falls back to advice.move (fails closed, no new randomness). Chart/style JSON additions are shipped data validated at import, with no markup or template tokens beyond existing {def:} usage in explanations.ts. No new dependencies, secrets, file I/O or unbounded input.
